notes: ἐπὶ πολύ → long is the main judgment call: a single English word renders the pair, so rule 94's precondition is met and rule 39's test keeps the unit aligned rather than noncompositional. Reading ἐπί as pleonastic and unrepresented under rule 34 remains defensible and the note records it.
The two supplied complementizers (t004, t034) go to the non-finite complements the ASV expands into finite clauses, not to the matrix verbs (rule 85).
their minds completes the single word μεταβαλόμενοι, which no other token licenses, so rule 103's added arm does not apply.
